stem.text: In this question it should be assumed that $(\text{NH}_4)_2\text{CO}_3.\text{H}_2\text{O(s)}$ dissolves in water without causing an increase in volume.
Which mass of $(\text{NH}_4)_2\text{CO}_3.\text{H}_2\text{O(s)}$ should be added to $800\,\text{cm}^{3}$ of water to form a $0.100\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ solution of $\text{NH}_4^{+}$ ions?
